activity.notes: Urban II was pope from 12 March 1088 until 29 July 1099. He called the First Crusade, but ATLAS does not model the later Crusader States as a polity ruled by him: they were separate political entities established by crusaders in the eastern Mediterranean. His primary sovereign polity here is the Papal States.

sources.title: Urban II
sources.citation_text: The Holy See's official pontiff record identifies Urban II as the 159th pope and gives his pontificate as 12 March 1088 to 29 July 1099.
